# Daemon

> Daemon is a desktop pet for Windows, made by Corner. You hatch one egg on your desktop and raise the little pet
> inside. He lives on your desktop, walks along your taskbar and keeps you company while you work.

Pet him until his eyes close, dress him in hats, give him a bed, throw him a ball, and send him to sleep over at a
friend's PC while you peek in. Each egg hatches a different creature, and he learns from the way you live, so no two
pets end up the same. He never dies and there is nothing to keep alive: no hunger meter, no chores.

- Platform: Windows (Steam). Release date: coming soon. A free demo is on Steam.
- Developer and publisher: Corner.
